one_month_reasoning: No company earnings fall inside the window: Lattice reported Q3 2025 on Nov 3 and Q3 2026 is expected around Nov 3, 2026 after the close, i.e. after the 2026-11-01 target date (Nov 1 is a Sunday, so the effective mark is the Oct 30 close). In-window items are second-order: ASPEED's September monthly sales (around Oct 6-10), which have been a clean read on server/BMC demand (ten straight monthly records, Aug +118% y/y); OCP Global Summit in mid-October where Lattice usually shows datacenter control/security products; and hyperscaler/AI-semi earnings late October (capex commentary moves the AI-server group, which LSCC trades with). Pre-earnings run-up into a guided 65% y/y FPGA quarter is a mild positive, offset by the stock's sharp rebound from about $107-120 in mid-September to $134 (reversal risk). Net: essentially symmetric spread centred about $134.5, with a slightly reduced monthly sigma (~16.5%, vs 61%/3.5 = 17.4%) because no earnings print is in the window.

fair_value.method: Blend of forward P/E (2028E non-GAAP EPS $3.45 x 42x = $145, 50%), EV/sales (2028E revenue $1.65B x 12x less ~$0.6B net debt over 146M shares = $131, 30%) and the Street consensus target (~$164.5, 20%), giving about $145 a year out.

bear.story: AI-server build pauses or hyperscaler capex digestion in 2027; FPGA growth slows to single digits after 2026 pull-in (ASPEED's supply-constraint catch-up flatters H2 2026 demand), AMI integration friction with silicon-neutral customers, multiple compresses to ~30x on ~$2.6B EPS with leverage overhang.

base.story: FPGA grows ~30% in 2027 on rising server attach (3+ units per server), AMI grows ~25%, EPS ~$2.75 in 2027 and ~$3.45 in 2028; multiple compresses from ~49x to low 40s so the stock roughly tracks earnings minus de-rating.

bull.story: Companion-chip/BMC-plus-FPGA platform wins share in next-gen AI racks, Industrial & Embedded recovery continues, revenue tracks the $3B-by-2030 path and 2028 EPS approaches $4+, market keeps a ~50x multiple.

thesis_break_reason: Below ~$85 (about 30x my 2027E EPS and below the pre-AMI-close trading range) the market would be pricing a real break: a guide-down in Compute & Communications/AI-server FPGA revenue, evidence that 2026 strength was supply-catch-up inventory build (watch ASPEED monthly sales rolling over), or AMI customer attrition. Ordinary 61%-vol drawdowns to ~$105-110 (seen in mid-September 2026) do not by themselves break the thesis.

reasoning: Facts: Q2 2026 revenue $201.1M (+62% y/y), non-GAAP GM 71.7%, EPS $0.53, FCF margin 40%; Q3 guide $245-265M incl. ~$35M two-month AMI, EPS $0.54-0.58; AMI closed Jul 27 for $1.0B cash (funded by $925M term loan) plus stock; 142.0M shares outstanding. Management targets a $1.2B exit-2026 run rate and $3B revenue by 2030. Alternative-lane evidence: ASPEED, the ~70-80% share BMC vendor that Lattice now partners with and whose chips sit next to Lattice FPGAs on server boards, posted its 10th straight monthly record in August (+118% y/y) with visibility into 2028, corroborating strong server control-plane demand into H2 2026 but also flagging that part of the jump is supply catch-up. Insider Form 144 sales in Aug-Sep were small (~$0.2-2M lots), not a red flag. Job-posting data show steady (not explosive) hiring; employee career-outlook ratings slipped ~9% y/y, a weak integration-strain signal. Independent research (Futurum) frames this as an AI content-expansion cycle; retail/social channels (StockTwits) are bullish but add no verified facts. X and Reddit yielded nothing usable via reachable pages. Valuation: blended fair value ~$145 vs $134 spot, i.e. modest upside because the stock already prices ~49x 2027E EPS. Distribution: lognormal around a ~$138 median with ~52% annual sigma (below 61% realized, which included the AMI/earnings shock year, but still high given AI-cycle beta), tails fattened slightly; scenario mix (25% $80 / 50% $140 / 25% $215) gives mean ~$144, consistent. Research was limited by paywalls on consensus estimates (Twelve Data plan) and blocked transcript pages.
